# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_rename_event.txt - edit the source.
# Rename news event (game rule rn_rename_event, off by default). Called by the single country-name
# carrier (rn_country_name_carrier.txt) around every change of a player-given name: a new name and a
# reset, for the own country (politics editor, legacy window) and for a subject.
#
# The old name. After the change the old text is gone, so it is kept before, as character codes on the
# renamed country (rn_prev_n, rn_prev_n_len), drawn by the RN_OLD_<slot> tables in the event:
#   1. capie_pf1_len / capie_pf1_0..31: the name the editor showed at Apply (its prefill carrier),
#      which is the displayed name (player name > cosmetic tag > base name). PROPOSED CAPIE record
#      (API level 5): the codes of prefill carrier 1, added to the Apply of a grammar editor.
#   2. otherwise the current player-given name layer (capie_cn_n), when there is one;
#   3. otherwise nothing: the event uses its "new name only" title.
# Codes above 84 (CAPIE's wider alphabet) are not drawn by Rename Anything's tables.

# Scope: the country about to change its name.
rn_rename_event_capture = {
	clear_array = rn_prev_n
	set_variable = { rn_prev_n_len = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:capie_pf1_len > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:capie_pf1_len > 0 } } add_to_array = { rn_prev_n = temp_var:capie_pf1_0 } }

# Scope: the country that just changed its name. A major news event, so every player reads it.
rn_rename_event_fire = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_rename_event option = RN_RENAME_EVENT_ON } }
		random_list = {
			25 = { set_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 1 } }
			25 = { set_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 2 } }
			25 = { set_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 3 } }
			25 = { set_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 4 } }
		}
		news_event = { id = rn_rename.1 }
	}
}
